name: McGrath Limited
summary: McGrath Limited operates as an integrated residential real estate services company in Australia. It operates through Company Owned Sales, Company Owned Property Management, Franchise Services, and Other Services segments. The company provides residential property sales, property management, mortgage broking, auction, and real estate training and conferences, as well as manages franchise offices. As of June 30, 2020, it operated 30 owned offices and 67 franchise offices. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Pyrmont, Australia.
